text: minervini: 'Near-vertical thrust ... the power-play precondition.' A precondition is not a setup, and you concede 'No flag yet'. In my canon a near-vertical run is where C19 exits the whole position; without the flag there is no test, first pullback or breakout to buy (C2). We converge on one observable: a tight range that resolves up on volume would be a C12 breakout and I would support it. day_vol 0.97 today is no such resolution.
